props.text: Rosemary and garlic lamb, golden potatoes and all the good things on the side. The shopping list grows with your guest list.
The centerpiece, with gravy and mint sauce
Make the crumble, marinate the lamb and set the table.
200°C for 20 minutes, then 180°C for about 25 minutes per 500 g.
Parboil, rough up the edges and roast in hot fat.
Rest the lamb for 20 minutes while the vegetables finish.
The crumble goes in as you sit down.
